title: Publication, managed workspaces and GitHub security review evidence
notice: These are historical model reviews of specific source snapshots, followed by human/agent verification and corrective changes. They are not an unconditional security certification or publication approval. Raw prompts/responses remain private; this public artifact intentionally omits operator topology, absolute personal paths, API/session identifiers, tokens and costs.

reviews.stage: Git broker and workspace adversarial review

reviews.conclusion: No remaining blocker or regression found in the supplied corrective deltas. Additional low-severity notes were independently checked below.

findings.summary: Codegraph cross-project symlink concern was conditional on unseen code.
evidence: services/codegraph/policy.mjs: sourcePath/sourceText compare the exact project root, use O_NOFOLLOW and verify the opened descriptor.
services/codegraph/worker.mjs: synchronize copies checked source text into adapter-owned per-project mirrors; SDK never opens source workspaces.

findings.summary: Git accepts only lease-derived capabilities; standalone capability endpoint no longer offers Git scopes. Original reviewer statement that ordinary members could mint capabilities was incorrect: issuance already required project admin.
evidence: hub/src/evolved/store.ts: capability exposes leaseId only after current lease/ACL/profile validation.
hub/src/evolved/github.test.ts: standalone capability rejection; hub/tests/github.integration.test.ts uses an actual runner lease.

findings.summary: Nested mounts are checked in both Hub and runner mount namespaces.
evidence: hub/src/evolved/workspaces.test.ts and services/runner-proxy/supervisor.test.ts: nested/escaped/sibling mount snapshots.
deploy/evolved/runner.compose.yml explicitly requires rprivate; validate-runner-vm.mjs checks actual propagation and rejects shared/slave/missing values.

findings.summary: Only the installation operator controls Docker host bind sources. Managed paths require the project UUID and identical container root; this is not remote proof against a malicious host administrator.
evidence: deploy/evolved/check-runner.ts and check-runner.test.ts: strict prefix/UUID/profile checks.
services/runner-proxy/supervisor.ts: compares authority project/profile/root and local realpath.

findings.summary: Upload slots are reserved before body buffering, unnecessary copies removed, Vault memory budget raised.
evidence: hub/src/evolved/vaultServer.ts: maximum two admissions before readGitBody, released on EOF/error/cancel.
hub/src/evolved/vault.ts and githubBroker.ts: zero-copy Buffer views.

findings.summary: Hub checks broker status/MIME/content encoding and projects only safe response headers.
evidence: hub/src/evolved/github.test.ts: malicious status/MIME and incidental credential-header regression.

findings.summary: Repository grant generation derives from monotone connection revision, preventing revoke/regrant ABA.
evidence: hub/src/evolved/githubBroker.test.ts: stale in-flight request after disconnect/connect/regrant fails even if the provider ignores cancellation; a new request succeeds.

findings.summary: GitHub smart HTTP addresses repository names, not immutable IDs. Identity is checked immediately before transfer and redirects fail closed; delete/recreate between API identity check and Git request cannot be eliminated locally.
evidence: hub/src/evolved/githubBroker.ts: repository identity recheck and redirect:error.

findings.summary: An authorized management request can commit before a later access revocation. Its response is suppressed after revalidation, and Vault retains the operation audit. Cancel does not promise rollback of a remote Git push.
evidence: hub/src/evolved/githubBroker.ts: audit and explicit inspect-refs-before-retry errors.

findings.summary: Managed roots cannot overlap operator state or credential directories. The two dedicated project-workspaces/managed-workspaces state children remain supported.
evidence: hub/src/evolved/runtime.ts: validates before and after canonical root creation.
hub/src/evolved/workspaces.test.ts: operator-state and credential overlap regression.

findings.summary: Hub, Codegraph and runner use the configured service UID for 0700 project access. Container mounts, not UID separation, prevent runner access to sibling projects and credential parents.

There is no account-disable/delete API. Missing users fail authentication. Passkey removal revokes capabilities, leases and other sessions while retaining the freshly verified current session; the final passkey cannot be removed. Recovery revokes all sessions/capabilities/leases. Project deletion marks deleting_at before purge and removes leases.
Role/profile revocation permanently revokes leases, even if the original role/profile is subsequently restored.
Signed Vault admission expiry is enforced during upload and immediately before Git execution, without consuming the nonce twice.
evidence: hub/src/evolved/githubBroker.test.ts: slow expired upload does not reach GitHub.

findings.summary: Pending project creation is aborted when account or administrator role changes, preventing stale step-up replay under a new context. GitHub token forms already clear on submit and abort on context changes; credentials never enter mutation/query caches.
Operator-state and credential locations now resolve existing symlinked parents before overlap comparison, including not-yet-created credential files.
evidence: hub/src/evolved/workspaces.test.ts: state alias and credential-parent alias regressions;13 workspace tests passed.

findings.summary: Deleting a project marks deleting_at before the Vault call, causing Hub authorization polls to fail. Vault purge calls GithubBroker.purge, which synchronously aborts all active project transfers before removing credentials/grants. No additional group mechanism required.
Only failures before Git admission are reclassified as an expired capability. A push failing after admission preserves its transport error and inspect-remote-refs guidance.
evidence: hub/src/evolved/vaultServer.ts: admitted flag gates expiry classification.
hub/src/evolved/githubBroker.test.ts: push failure after the 31-second admission deadline remains 502, not 401.

findings.summary: A FIFO with a source extension cannot block the Codegraph worker during open. O_NONBLOCK is combined with O_NOFOLLOW and the existing descriptor isFile check.
evidence: services/codegraph/test/policy.test.mjs: real Linux FIFO in an isolated subprocess with timeout;3 policy tests passed.

findings.summary: Native non-container Vault operation requires a separate service account and private state outside Hub/Runner/workspace directories. Compose uses separate credential/state mounts.

credentialBoundary: The human-entered PAT necessarily exists transiently in the browser submit and the authenticated TLS request through Hub to Vault. Persistent encrypted storage and authenticated GitHub consumption are Vault-only. Agent/runner clients receive neither PAT nor the sidecar lease/short capability. No operator gh credential was read or copied.

workspaceBoundary.automatic: Every new project with omitted/empty rootPath receives a server-generated UUID directory; current projects are not silently migrated.
workspaceBoundary.manual: Installation administrator plus fresh passkey, explicit allowed roots, canonical paths, protected-directory filtering, no duplicate/parent/child/bind-alias binding.
workspaceBoundary.rollback: Only empty newly allocated directory with original inode; never recursive removal. Project deletion retains source files.
workspaceBoundary.upgrade: Create the managed root with the configured UID and mode0700 before Compose starts; Docker-created root-owned0755 bind directories are rejected. Missing/symlinked configured roots deliberately fail closed.

secretAudit.disposition: All six candidates were false positives: two SHA256 checksums of a literal attachment fixture, one local E2E context token, one synthetic iOS route-test token, two ordinary Cursor documentation paragraphs. No credential values are reproduced.
secretAudit.limitations: Frozen pre-change tracked snapshot and locally available refs only. Scanner absence is not proof; remote-only refs/actions artifacts, images and unpublished refs require a release-time check. Custom privacy scan examined13040 historical text blobs; eight large binary archives were excluded from that text scan. No history rewrite occurred. Tip sanitization does not erase historical operator paths.

validation.targetedAfterCorrections: 38 tests passed across workspace, security, Git routes and actual native Git integration; Hub typecheck passed.
validation.scope: Local isolated synthetic fixtures; no live GitHub credentials or infrastructure mutation in these tests.

publicationGate: Repository visibility remains unchanged. Preserve original AGPL and MIT-derived CLI/tool notices. Review historical personal metadata and release artifact licenses before any future public release.

postReviewChecks.additionalModelReview: None required for the final small canonical-path and nonblocking-file-open fixes; reviewed locally and regression-tested.

clarifications: Passkey removal retains the current freshly verified session and revokes other sessions; a model statement saying all sessions was overly broad. Recovery revokes all sessions.
Disconnect increments connection generation/revision, and stillGranted verifies the captured connection generation as well as grant generation.
Compose project bind propagation is explicitly rprivate; preflight allows only ro/rw mode values and the VM validator checks the actual mount propagation.
No publication visibility change, credential rotation, history rewrite, or infrastructure change is performed by this review artifact.
